notes.title: Statistics update!
notes.content:
K, guys, we are planning to add statistics to find out who is the best daber.
We have unreal, unbelievable, crazy amount of sales - something about 3! About 3 people bought our game, so let's find out who is the fastest, smartest and loves silly games more than everyone!
Also, we need your answers. Perhaps, just perhaps - game starts way too out of the box, so you immediatley under the pressure, should we make learning curve easier, like make free 5-7 days about 1 minute, and maybe give more time to pick themes? Write you thoughts, muh bois!ːsteamhappyː
